INTERNAL REVENUE SERVICE — EXAMINATION DIVISION
Revenue Agent Report (Form 4549 summary)

Taxpayer: Michael A. Okafor and Diane R. Okafor
Tax Year: 2022
Examining Agent: R. Falkenberg, Revenue Agent, ID# 88-2214
Examination Method: Bank Deposits and Cash Expenditures Method (IRM 4.10.4.6.3)
30-Day Letter Issued: November 4, 2024

Basis for Indirect Method

The taxpayers' books and records for Okafor Strategic Consulting (Schedule C, sole
proprietorship operated by Michael A. Okafor) were incomplete for the period under exam. In the
absence of adequate books and records, the examining agent is authorized under IRC Section 446(b)
to reconstruct income by any method that clearly reflects income, including the bank deposits
method.

Bank Deposits Analysis — Piedmont Trust Bank, business account ending 4471

  Total deposits, calendar year 2022 ........................... $186,400.00
  Less: gross receipts per return .............................. $138,800.00
  Unidentified deposits (treated as unreported income) ......... $ 47,600.00

Note: Taxpayer was asked at the July 18, 2024 initial interview to identify the source of all
deposits exceeding $137,000 in the account. Taxpayer's representative stated that "some of it is
just money moving between our own accounts" but did not provide supporting documentation prior to
issuance of this report. Absent such documentation, all unidentified deposits are treated as
gross receipts per Tax Reform Act guidance on indirect methods.

Schedule C Expense Disallowances

  Vehicle expense (mileage) .................................... $ 9,800.00 — no mileage log produced
  Home office expense ........................................... $ 4,200.00 — no square-footage
                                                                                 calculation or Form 8829
  Contract labor ................................................ $ 4,400.00 — no Forms 1099-NEC issued;
                                                                                 no invoices produced

Penalty Recommendation

Accuracy-related penalty under IRC Section 6662(a)/(b)(2) recommended based on a substantial
understatement of income tax exceeding the greater of $5,000 or 10% of the tax required to be
shown on the return.

Agent's Note: Taxpayer's representative (CPA) indicated during the exam that a portion of the
deposits may relate to a personal loan repayment and an inter-account transfer, but did not
provide documentation before the 30-day letter deadline. Recommend Appeals consider any
substantiation submitted post-report.
